0022600091.text: Both the Houston Rockets and Dallas Mavericks open their 2026-27 seasons in this regular-season game, with the Rockets hosting. Steven Adams is day-to-day for Houston with a rest reason, while Dallas is without Dereck Lively II (foot, surgery), Jett Howard (illness), Max Christie (rest), Santi Aldama (knee), and Tarik Biberovic (heel), all listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 2-2, and the Rockets won the last meeting 111-107 in Houston on January 31, 2026, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives Houston a 70% chance of winning.
